run_quantization_oneshot: run FP8 block quantization on a Llama 3.1 model using AutoRound with AutoRoundModifier recipe
create_quantization_recipe: create an AutoRoundModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with FP8_BLOCK scheme and lm_head ignored
build_calibration_dataset: build a calibration dataset from a tokenizer with configurable sequence length and sample count
test_quantized_model: test a quantized model by generating text with dispatch_model and tokenizer decode
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk with compression enabled
